summary.verdict: The 42-unit route is a defensible candidate. The three holds are specific evidence disputes, not default deferrals; all other 39 units have affirmative support from at least two of the three decision-local roles. The boss preserved every material losing position found in the six source artifacts as one of 17 append-only dissents.
summary.coverage: All 357 local WEB Daniel coordinates occur exactly once, in order, from Dan.1.1 through Dan.12.13.

Keep Dan.10.10-Dan.11.1 cross-chapter despite the preserved 10:19|10:20 dissent.

Refuse singleton retrieval children at Dan.12.2, Dan.12.3, and Dan.12.4.

ruling_checks.challenge: The split lacks a section mark but is supported by a completed test and subject/form reset; parent hydration adequately answers the larger-unit objection.
The first child is short, but the pe, place change, participant change, and prayer form are specific evidence; the 2:14-23 larger view remains preserved.
The proclamation completes the reversal, but official inspection closes the ordeal and the blessing begins a genuine coda form; the whole 3:19-30 view remains preserved.
The active forward attachment is usable but not settled; the formula's anaphora and pe closure support backward attachment, and the whole realization-restoration view is separately preserved.
First-person restoration is a real coda, but it must remain mutually interpreting with the abasement and full proclamation.
The speech-to-enacted-outcome reset is specific; the route correctly keeps outcome hydration without treating the prediction and fulfillment as one form.
The active 5:29-6:3 transition is coherent, but both received WEB and MT-aligned alternatives remain viable; the hold must remain visibly versification-neutral.
The universal-address letter is a clear coda after release and accuser reversal; the complete 6:16-28 view remains preserved.
The renewed focused inquiry is a genuine dialogue turn even without a section mark; the 7:15-28 single-dialogue view remains preserved.
The first-person aftermath is formally visible but insufficient alone; merge is the stronger retrieval decision and the coda view remains an internal marker and appeal.
Completed mourning, pe, new day, and river location support the split, while preparation-to-encounter continuity is retained through the parent and appeal.
Continuous speaker and encounter plus the stronger 11:2 opening support the larger cross-chapter child, but the purpose/conflict preface at 10:20 is a credible internal movement.
Fourfold breakup closes a compact succession prologue and 11:5 begins the directional conflict register, but the prologue must never become a detached historical chart.
Renewed king language supports an identity-neutral rhetorical seam, while absent replacement, speaker reset, or section mark supports the larger unit; local evidence cannot settle this.
The doubled 'at that time' and continuous messenger speech outweigh the chapter boundary for top-level routing; the 12:1 culmination view remains preserved.
Section markers support internal navigation but not naked singleton retrieval; the losing hydrated-children view remains recorded.
The pe and renewed direct answer support two dialogue rounds, but both must hydrate together and the whole-dialogue view remains preserved.
